$comment: THE SCREENING RECORD. This is the auditable source of `wallets_screened` (M),
the input the README calls the most consequential and the one only the operator
knows. Before 2026-08-12 M was an argument in a handoff: '13 tracked plus 30
parked' where the 30 existed nowhere. It is now a count in this file.
APPEND ONLY. A wallet examined and rejected still counts toward M -- that is the
whole point of a selection correction. Never delete an entry to tidy the list;
deleting rejections is how M silently shrinks and every deflated win rate
M is len(entries), not the count of admitted wallets.
knownIncomplete: Anything screened and discarded before 2026-08-06 is unrecorded and cannot be recovered. M is therefore a FLOOR, and the floor is now auditable where before it was asserted.
